'''Snow Wolves''' was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] unit within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].

==History==
Along with [[Calm Tree/Legends|Calm Tree]] and [[Wildfire/Legends|Wildfire]], Snow Wolves was one of the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] units that were dispatched to aid [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] on the [[Raid on Nuvo Vindi's laboratory/Legends|raid on Nuvo Vindi's laboratory]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].
